body:
## Capability block 6: Workflow infrastructure as generated code

Treated workflow definitions as generated infrastructure rather than hand-built interface state. Python generators emit and maintain workflow definitions. When an orchestration pattern changes, the generator changes and dependent workflows can be regenerated.

Output and impact:

- Replaced repeated manual workflow editing with reusable generation logic.
- Allowed pattern changes to propagate without individually rebuilding many configurations.
- Made new workflow patterns a generator change rather than a sequence of interface edits.

Maintainability evidence:

- The source of truth is deterministic code rather than scattered manual configuration.
- Repeated structures can be changed consistently.
- Infrastructure becomes reviewable and reproducible.
